notes.title: Patch Notes for Build V025.3
notes.notes:
There was a small bug where you had click on the "Next Level" button after finishing the level to unlock the new level 
The Next Level is now unlocked automatically after the player completes the level

notes.title: Patch Notes for V025.02
notes.notes:
Fixed Steam achievements related to death 
Players will only get the achievement once they have died the required amount of times

notes.title: Patch Notes for Build V025.01 ( Mostly Minor Bug Fixes)
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes 

 Level #42 Leaderboards has been fixed (Previously not working)
 Unlocking the Skin 7 in the game previously bugged has been fixed

notes.title: Update V024.9
notes.notes:
Fixed the Level Menu 

Levels were previously all unlocked (which was not intended) 
Now the Levels need to be unlocked (as intended)

notes.title: Patch Notes for Build V024.9
notes.notes:
Bug where all levels were unlocked is fixed. 
Players will need to sequentially unlock levels
